'''Diatium''' was a metal substance used in small power cells as early as [[3951 BBY|four millennia BBY]].

[[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsabers]] generally used cylindrical [[Diatium power cell/Legends|diatium power cells]]. It was not a very rare [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]], in that it was easy to mine for helpful use.

==History==
Throughout the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] Diatium was a rather easy mineral to find, but that ease was lost due to the excessive mining of the powerful [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]].
